# OpenShift 4.21 Audit Trail & Critical-Resource Deletion Guardrails

> Production controls for an OpenShift 4.21 cluster with OpenShift GitOps (Argo CD): audit trail to SIEM + Loki, a two-person deletion rule enforced by ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (applies to cluster-admin), red alerts to email + Microsoft Teams, OADP backups, phased rollout. Start with AGENTS.md; it contains every fact an assistant needs.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules, facts, commands, read map for AI assistants (read this first)
- [llm/context.yaml](llm/context.yaml): the same facts, machine-readable
- [llm/memory.md](llm/memory.md): shared durable memory and current state (phase, last test, open risks)
- [README.md](README.md): human overview with architecture diagrams

## Skills (task procedures, Agent Skills format)
- [guardrail-delete](.claude/skills/guardrail-delete/SKILL.md): request → approve ×2 → execute a critical deletion
- [guardrail-investigate](.claude/skills/guardrail-investigate/SKILL.md): who deleted/changed an object (LogQL/SPL)
- [guardrail-verify](.claude/skills/guardrail-verify/SKILL.md): validate manifests locally and verify a cluster
- [guardrail-rollout](.claude/skills/guardrail-rollout/SKILL.md): move between phases safely
- [guardrail-incident](.claude/skills/guardrail-incident/SKILL.md): respond to a guardrail alert

- [docs/17-impersonation-control.md](docs/17-impersonation-control.md): impersonation restricted to reads, access reviews and dry-runs via RBAC (no userextras) + admission markers
